_panel_geomean.iqm_method: scipy.stats.trim_mean semantics, proportiontocut=0.25; with n=3 it trims nothing and equals the mean
_panel_geomean.paired_null_definition: 95th percentile of |mean of 3 signed same-model pairwise seed deltas| under a bootstrap over the 6-element signed null pool (Du, paired per-seed deltas)
_panel_geomean.seed_mce_definition: max(spread_maxmin, paired_null_95) — guarantees a usable constant even when the conservative paired protocol declares nothing

_protocol.mdd_scored: relative bootstrap width of the SCORED copy-LF reference cell (probe D0); identically 0 for paper-bar references
_protocol.ratio_of_normals_caveat: the documented ratio-of-normals caveat applies to cahn_hilliard (denominator uncertainty large => normal approximation fails)
_protocol.row_paired_95: 95th pct of |mean per-row skill delta| under a paired row bootstrap of same-model seed pairs
_protocol.tau_abs: tau_rel + mdd_scored * skill_level — absolute-bar or cross-era claims (the reference does not cancel); skill_level = the certifier's IQM skill on that dataset
_protocol.tau_rel: max(seed_mce, row_paired_95) — same-reference, within-era arm comparisons (the reference cancels in the ratio)

_source: r3s4_audit-B1 condition->HF 3-seed spread (family r3s4_cert_min, smoke tier 200 epochs, seeds 0,1,2) fused with a paired test-row bootstrap of the scored cell
